mechanism: The model result is a TLC state-writer/disk I/O abort, not a safety or liveness result: TLC parsed the modules and generated the initial state, then failed in StatePoolWriter.run. The lower-level I/O cause is not shown, and no trace or counterexample was produced.
evidence: Model result.json records 'Finished computing initial states: 1 distinct state generated', followed by 'Error: when writing the disk (StatePoolWriter.run)', with decision-replay seeing '0 traces' and verdict UNEXPLAINED model-error. In implementation seed1-rep1, storage s seq1 accepts token 1 at ledger 0; env seq6 heals the partition and seq7 applies the last clock fault. The subsequent c2 Grant at n3 seq9 has counted, eligible agreements from n3, n4 and n5 at n3 seq6–8, while the incarnation-1 agreements from n1 and n2 at n3 seq3–4 have counted_toward: [].
reasoning: There is no PASS/FAIL divergence: the implementation sampled executions and passed them, while the model never checked H13. The shown implementation execution is consistent with the schedule and clauses it exercises. Before the heal, c2's partition contains only two eligible members, n3 and n4, which is not a majority of five; after the heal and last fault, n3, n4 and n5 supply three eligible counted agreements, satisfying C3.7, and c2 receives its outstanding grant. The token-2 grant follows token 1, and the shown write acceptance and acknowledgement are consistent with C1.2/C1.3. Thus no side claims a violation and none is exhibited. The locus is the model-side checking infrastructure, not a demonstrated defect in the TLA+ specification, implementation, inputs or interface. The implementation README expressly says its runs are sampled executions, not proof, so its PASSes do not settle all H13 behaviours.
what_would_settle_it: The complete TLC exception and system diagnostic would settle the writer's underlying I/O cause. A completed run of the unchanged H13 model, with its verdict, exported traces and replay report, would settle the model-side result; the implementation's 30 sampled PASSes cannot do that.
